notices.title: DNREC Announces First Fall 2026 Avian Influenza Cases Detected in Delaware Migratory Waterfowl
notices.summary: HPAI was detected in migratory waterfowl at Little Creek Wildlife Area in eastern Kent County during USDA-APHIS surveillance in early fall 2026.

notices.title: Delaware announces presumptive positive avian influenza case in Sussex County commercial flock
notices.summary: Delaware reported a presumptive positive H5 HPAI case in a Sussex County commercial poultry flock, which is being depopulated.

notices.title: Delaware Department of Agriculture reminds residents of poultry safety tips as avian influenza season arrives
notices.summary: Delaware Department of Agriculture urges residents to practice poultry safety as avian influenza risk rises with colder weather and migratory season.

notices.title: Preliminary Testing Confirms Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza in Worcester County
notices.summary: Preliminary state testing found HPAI H5N1 at a commercial broiler operation in Worcester County; NVSL confirmation pending, flock being depopulated.
